Pachinko Fever — Cursed Technique Reversal

Your mastery over the Reverse Cursed Technique has granted you your technique’s reversal. Whenever you expand your domain, instead of rolling for a jackpot, you can force all creatures within your domain to roll for a Jackpot following the usual rules of your domain. On a Jackpot, a creature is rewarded with 10 cursed energy. On a failure, the creature loses all their current cursed energy and cannot regain cursed energy for 1 minute.
